meta.title: PIE-Block MCP bridge
meta.description: Connects the running PIE-Block desktop app to DSH. With the app's AI 接入（MCP） switch on, its six project tools appear as mcp__pieblock__* so the agent can read the open project, validate it, propose and apply configuration changes, and read the generated C code. It applies a patch only when asked and never starts the app: tools disappear when the app closes or the switch is turned off. Loopback only; nothing leaves this machine.
